Hi Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to move Novamed from PoC to pilot for two core capabilities: 1) streaming real-time clinical note generation (low latency, token-by-token streaming to our UI) and 2) function/tool calling to trigger structured lookups against our patient registry and medication database.

Attached is a rough workflow (novamed-workflow_v1.pdf) that shows where we want streaming vs synchronous calls. Key constraints: our UI expects structured JSON objects conforming to a strict schema (we can share the schema), and all tool calls must include an idempotency key.

Can Redwood share a recommended rollout plan and a sample structured-output schema so our engineers can validate? Also want to confirm support for webhooks vs long-polling for streaming.

Emily

Great to see the workflow, thanks for sending. High level we recommend a three-phase rollout:

1) Integration kickoff & schema alignment (1 week): confirm the structured JSON contract + test vectors.
2) Pilot (2–3 weeks): enable streaming output to your staging UI with function-calling proxies to your dev DB. We'll run load tests and measure end-to-end latency.
3) Production cutover (1 week): increase capacity, enable canary routing and SLA monitoring.

I've attached our onboarding template (redwood-onboarding-template.json) that includes required fields for function calls, idempotency, and streaming session metadata. Can you confirm who will be the engineering lead and give a few sample messages (2–3) that match your expected schema?

Hi Emily —

Thanks Ben. A few implementation notes from CS/enablement before the kickoff:

- Streaming: Redwood supports server-sent events (SSE) and websocket streaming. For sub-200ms token latency we recommend websocket with our autoprefix caching enabled.
- Tool calling: we'll provide a function schema you register in the model config. Each call includes the payload and an idempotency token (x-idempotency-key). Redwood will surface call attempts and a 6-hour replay window in the console.
- Auth: we support bearer tokens and mutual-TLS for private deployments. For Hosted API, we recommend short-lived bearer tokens via our SDK.
- Rate limits: pilot tier default is 60 requests/min per workspace; we can increase for pilot in Dedicated if needed.

I've attached a simple implementation role sheet (implementation-roles.xlsx) with suggested responsibilities for Novamed, Redwood CS, and your SREs.

See you on Tue.

Best,
Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
